gloss_en: After importing IFC into Revit nothing shows in 3D view.

answer_summary: Seven checks: link/category visibility, phase filter, huge coordinates (move near origin), view range, element/filter hiding, section/visual style, detail level or update IFC add-in.

gloss_en: Revit shows missing or distorted elements when opening IFC; how to fix?
